nights.title: Gianna Nannini | GIANNAGOLD
nights.name: Gianna Nannini
nights.extract: Gianna Nannini is an Italian singer and songwriter. Her most notable songs include "America" (1979), "Fotoromanza" (1984), "I maschi" (1987), "Meravigliosa creatura" (1995), "Sei nell'anima" (2006) and "Bello e impossibile" (1986). The latter became a hit across Europe, especially in Austria, Germany, Italy and Switzerland.

nights.title: DAMIEN RICE
nights.name: Damien Rice
nights.extract: Damien George Rice is an Irish singer-songwriter. He began his career as a member of the 1990s rock group Juniper, who were signed to Polygram Records in 1997. The band enjoyed moderate success in Ireland with two released singles, "The World is Dead" and "Weatherman." After leaving the band in 1998, Rice worked as a farmer in Tuscany and busked throughout Europe before returning to Ireland in 2001 and beginning a solo career. The rest of Juniper went on to perform under the name Bell X1.

de.who: Damien George Rice ist ein irischer Singer-Songwriter. Er begann seine Karriere in der Rockgruppe Juniper und startete nach seiner Rückkehr nach Irland eine Solokarriere.
facts: Er begann seine Karriere als Mitglied der Rockgruppe Juniper aus den 1990er Jahren, die 1997 bei Polygram Records unter Vertrag stand.

Nachdem er die Band 1998 verlassen hatte, arbeitete Rice als Bauer in der Toskana und musizierte als Straßenmusiker in ganz Europa, bevor er 2001 nach Irland zurückkehrte und eine Solokarriere begann.

facts: Kariyerine, 1997'de Polygram Records ile sözleşme imzalayan 1990'ların rock grubu Juniper'ın bir üyesi olarak başladı.
Rice, 1998'de gruptan ayrıldıktan sonra Toskana'da çiftçi olarak çalıştı ve Avrupa genelinde sokak müzisyenliği yaptı; 2001'de İrlanda'ya dönüp solo kariyerine başladı.

nights.title: GUÈ - LIVE 2027
nights.name: Guè
nights.extract: Cosimo Fini, known professionally as Guè, previously as Gué Pequeno, is an Italian rapper. He is also a member of the famous hip hop group Club Dogo with rapper Jake La Furia and producer Don Joe. Between 1999 and 2001, he was also in "Sacre Scuole", a group made up by Gué Pequeno, Dargen D'Amico and Jake La Furia. In his career he collaborated with international artists such as Benny the Butcher, Kool G Rap, Akon, Rick Ross and Jadakiss.

nights.extract: Fontaines D.C. are an Irish rock band formed in Dublin in 2014. The band consists of Grian Chatten (vocals), Conor Curley (guitar), Conor "Deego" Deegan III (bass), Tom Coll (drums), and Carlos O'Connell (guitar).

nights.title: Beth Hart | Roma Summer Fest
nights.name: Beth Hart
nights.extract: Beth Hart is an American musician from Los Angeles, California. She rose to fame with the release of her 1999 single "L.A. Song " from her second album Screamin' for My Supper. The single was a number one hit in New Zealand, as well as reaching the top five of the US Adult Contemporary and Top 10 on the Billboard Adult Top 40 charts.
